:error catches script errors, $error holds the message, /reseterror clears it, $$ halts.
-- origin --
spec
-- script.mrc --
alias fail { set }
alias guarded {
  fail
  echo -s not reached
  :error
  echo -s caught: $error
  reseterror
}
alias need { echo -s got $$1 }
alias test {
  guarded
  echo -s continues
  need
  echo -s after need
}
-- output --
caught: /set: invalid parameters (line 1, script.mrc)
continues
